# Search Index Mapping — facts

> Source-anchored units about Search Index Mapping: 17 across 8 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-24 · 17 units · 8 sources · rights: quote -->

## How it works

- [statement] Autocomplete is absent from the default dynamic type set but can be added through a custom typeSet. MongoDB recommends static autocomplete mappings because broad dynamic autocomplete increases index size, resource use, and scoring risks. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/search/indexes/define-field-mappings.md · keywords: Search Index Mapping · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/search/performance/index-performance.md
- [statement] Index only fields needed by the search workload when their names are known. MongoDB and Mongoose recommend static mappings to reduce unnecessary index storage and resource usage. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/search/performance/index-performance.md · keywords: Search Index Mapping · also: https://mongoosejs.com/docs/atlas-search.html
- [statement] Dynamic indexing of arbitrary field names can cause mapping explosions, increasing mongot memory consumption and potentially crashing it. MongoDB recommends restricting mappings or restructuring keys into a tuple-like schema. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/search/performance/index-performance.md · keywords: Search Index Mapping

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Static nested-field mappings require definitions for each parent; dotted field names cannot replace that hierarchy. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/search/indexes/define-field-mappings.md · keywords: Search Index Mapping
- [statement] With mappings.dynamic:true, the default type set applies. A named custom typeSet can change dynamically indexed types; document, embeddedDocuments, vector, and deprecated field types are excluded from custom type sets. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/search/indexes/define-field-mappings.md · keywords: Search Index Mapping

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] MongoDB recommends limiting dynamic mappings to changing or unknown fields inside a document rather than enabling them indiscriminately at the root. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/search/indexes/define-field-mappings.md · keywords: Search Index Mapping
- [statement] TCGplayer’s benchmark repository keeps collection and Search mapping definitions in src/mongo_bench/resources/bench_collections.json and directs test plans to reference that file or its commit and path. Its index named bench_search_dynamic_all actually uses dynamic:false, showing why benchmark interpretation must inspect definitions rather than names. (low confidence) — https://github.com/TCGplayer/ims-mongo-test · keywords: Search Index Mapping

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Dynamic mappings automatically index supported fields, while mappings.dynamic:false with mappings.fields selects explicit fields and search types. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/search/indexes/define-field-mappings.md · keywords: Search Index Mapping · also: https://mongoosejs.com/docs/atlas-search, https://tapptitude.com/blog/atlas-search, https://mongoosejs.com/docs/atlas-search.html, https://docs.percona.com/percona-search-for-mongodb/search-indexes.html
- [statement] Static definitions override dynamic treatment per field. To index one field as both string and autocomplete, explicitly include both types in its static mapping array. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/search/indexes/define-field-mappings.md · keywords: Search Index Mapping · also: https://tapptitude.com/blog/atlas-search
- [statement] Dynamic indexing can include unnecessary fields and increase storage use. Static mappings can reduce the index footprint by restricting indexed fields; a universal query-latency improvement is not established. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/search/performance/index-performance.md · keywords: Search Index Mapping · also: https://mongoosejs.com/docs/atlas-search, https://tapptitude.com/blog/atlas-search
- [statement] The documented configurable dynamic syntax permits mappings.dynamic to reference a named typeSet, whose field-type configurations are defined in the top-level typeSets array. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/search/indexes/define-field-mappings.md · keywords: Search Index Mapping · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/DRIVERS-3295
- [statement] A static field definition can carry analyzer settings independently for each string field; Mongoose demonstrates lucene.standard, lucene.english, and lucene.keyword configurations inside mappings.fields. (low confidence) — https://mongoosejs.com/docs/atlas-search · keywords: Search Index Mapping
- [statement] Mongoose lets applications declare mapping JSON with schema.searchIndex() and create declared search indexes with Model.createSearchIndexes(); its examples include static typed fields and field-specific analyzers. (low confidence) — https://mongoosejs.com/docs/atlas-search.html · keywords: Search Index Mapping · also: https://mongoosejs.com/docs/atlas-search
- [statement] Omitting mappings.dynamic defaults to false in the mapping definition, even though MongoDB performance guidance describes the default index-creation configuration as dynamic. Set the value explicitly. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/search/indexes/define-field-mappings.md · keywords: Search Index Mapping · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/search/performance/index-performance.md
- [statement] Pureinsights describes MAPT experiments that supply mappings, representative data, and queries, then measure indexing and query performance under configurable concurrency. The tool was developed with MongoDB; this is methodology, not independent proof of a static-mapping speedup. (low confidence) — https://pureinsights.com/blog/2024/revolutionizing-search-performance-meet-mapt/ · keywords: Search Index Mapping
- [statement] A Reddit author reported unchanged Artillery load-test results after replacing a smaller static mapping with a dynamic mapping on an M0 cluster. This uncontrolled observation does not establish a general latency relationship. (low confidence) — https://www.reddit.com/r/mongodb/comments/1nui0we · keywords: Search Index Mapping
- [statement] Percona Search documents dynamic mappings, including newly added supported fields, and explicit static mappings for its own MongoDB Search implementation. This corroborates mapping concepts across implementations, not a benchmark advantage. (low confidence) — https://docs.percona.com/percona-search-for-mongodb/search-indexes.html · keywords: Search Index Mapping
